steps.en: OCMS labels each offender as company, NRIC, FIN or passport
steps.id: OCMS menandai offender sebagai company, NRIC, FIN atau passport

steps.en: Local NRIC holders are sent to the immigration authority for follow-up
steps.id: Pemegang NRIC lokal dikirim ke otoritas imigrasi untuk follow-up

steps.en: FIN and company offenders are sent to the data agency for follow-up
steps.id: Offender FIN dan company dikirim ke lembaga data untuk follow-up
steps.why_en: Built, but this daily job is switched off in the live environment.
steps.why_id: Sudah dibuat, tetapi job harian ini dimatikan di lingkungan live.

steps.en: Foreign passport holders get their own follow-up route
steps.id: Pemegang foreign passport punya jalur follow-up sendiri
steps.why_en: No lookup route exists for passport holders; only e-notification skipping is built.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada jalur lookup untuk pemegang passport; hanya pelewatan e-notification yang dibuat.

steps.en: A deceased status from the authorities triggers the right action
steps.id: Status meninggal dari otoritas memicu tindakan yang tepat
steps.why_en: NRIC path works, but the FIN path is off live and a live defect says results were not saved.
steps.why_id: Jalur NRIC jalan, tetapi jalur FIN mati di live dan ada defect live: hasil tidak tersimpan.
